obfuscation_indicators: beyond our ability to control or predict
risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and transparent about declining fourth-quarter sales, gross losses, staffing shortages, inflation, supply disruptions, and customer concentration. Full-year profitability was materially supported by a one-time property-sale gain, while the CEO vacancy and ongoing labor and demand pressures create meaningful execution risk. Management maintains a cautiously optimistic outlook but provides limited specific targets or timelines for remediation.
